C0637.title: Strictest Cross-Border E-Commerce Rule: Duplicate Listings to Lose All Exposure
C0637.summary: In May 2025, cross-border e-commerce platforms introduced a new rule stating that products with identical attributes and appearance will be classified as duplicate listings regardless of how they are published. Even the same product with different SKUs may be flagged. Flagged duplicate listings will receive zero exposure, making this the strictest regulation in history.

references.title: Breaking! The strictest new regulations are out! Cross-border e-commerce sellers may suffer heavy losses!
